title: 第11章 谁接谁一剑第12章 找死
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 陆寒的出现，立即引起了周围一阵哗然，显然，不管是元溯剑王，还是陆寒，周围之人都是如雷贯耳。
元溯剑王，此地为数不多的王境剑修之一，而且还是一位将剑意雏形领悟至圆满，距离领悟剑意只差临门一脚的超级剑修，一旦他领悟剑意，便将可以与临月城主那等顶级强者并列，而如今即便未曾领悟剑意，实力也要比暮月拍卖行之主那等王境要强不少。
想要拜其为师之人不知凡几，但这位元溯剑王眼光极其之高，至今也才收了两位弟子罢了，这陆寒，便是其中之一。
陆寒的话一出，不少人都是将羡慕的目光投向苏怜心。
此女当真是好福气，就看她接下来，能否接下陆寒公子一剑了。
陆寒公子，作为元溯剑王的二弟子，其剑道天赋非比寻常，别说是同境，哪怕是境界高过他的修士，都未必是他的对手。
接住其一剑，这看似简单的要求，其实并不简单。
看着那一上来，便开始自说自话的少年，苏怜心无语至极。
我什么时候说过要拜你师尊为师了？
目光直视着对方，苏怜心缓缓开口：“第一，我并不知晓你师尊是谁，也从未想过要拜他为师。”
“第二。”
话音到此，戛然而止，取而代之的是一道浩瀚剑光，从陆寒身侧骤然斩过，冷厉的罡风刮得其脸生疼。
突如其来的一剑，让擂台上下都安静了下来。
台上的陆寒，眼神愣然的看着眼前不远处的白衣少女，目光中的惊骇之色几乎要溢出。
那一剑……他连反应都没来得及反应。
换句话说，如果刚才那一剑，是冲着他来的话，那么他已经死了。
当然，这还不是最主要的，最主要的是，在那一道剑光之中，陆寒居然感知到了他难以理解的剑道真意……
那一丝剑道真意，令他毛骨悚然，腰间的长剑都在颤抖，仿佛是遇到了何种大恐怖一般。
身为剑修，他对那一丝剑道真意，再熟悉不过。
那正是他做梦都想要领悟的……剑意！
不是剑意雏形，而是真正的剑意！
那一丝剑道真意给他的感觉，比师尊还要强上不知多少倍！
师尊元溯剑王，已经是将剑意雏形领悟至圆满，再进一步便是真正的剑意。
在苏怜心所斩出的那一道剑光之中，他清晰的感觉到，所蕴含的剑道真意，远在师尊之上，这说明什么？
说明眼前的白衣少女，领悟的并非是剑道雏形，而是真正的剑意！
一个十六七岁的小姑娘，剑意？
如果不是亲眼所见，陆寒无论如何也不会相信。
要知道，连他师尊，一位王境剑修，都未曾领悟剑意啊！
眼前这位境界与自己相当的白衣少女，居然……领悟了连他师尊元溯剑王，都未曾领悟的剑意！
这一刻，别说是陆寒了，就连阁楼之上的元溯剑王，都猛然站起身来，手中的茶杯已经被他捏成粉末。
元溯剑王的震惊，并不比他那位弟子少多少。
距离领悟剑意越近，越是能够明白，想要将其领悟是有多么困难，别看外界传言，他元溯剑王距离领悟剑意，只差临门一脚，可只有他自己知道，那临门一脚有多难。
多少人都被卡在了这一阶段，绝大部分剑修一卡就是一辈子，至死也未能领悟剑意。
可他看到了什么？
一位年仅十五六岁的小姑娘，居然领悟了剑意……
这是什么妖孽？
这等妖孽，又怎么可能会出现在映月七国？
这已经不是天才能够形容的了。
本章未完，请翻下一页继续阅读.........杂役都是仙帝，你管这叫没落宗门最新章节第11章谁接谁一剑？，一剑？”
“拜师？”
斩出一剑后，苏怜心直接转身离开了，留下的两句话，却是深深刺痛了陆寒和阁楼之上那位元溯剑王的人。
可笑的是，元溯剑王居然妄图收对方为徒。
谁收谁为徒？
一个仅领悟剑意雏形的人，居然妄图收一位领悟了剑意之人为徒？
content_en:
The appearance of Lu Han immediately caused an uproar around him. Obviously, whether it was Sword King Yuansu or Lu Han, the people around him were thunderous.
Yuansu Sword King is one of the few king-level sword cultivators here, and he is also a super sword cultivator who has understood the rudimentary form of the sword's intention to perfection. He is only one step away from realizing the sword's intention. Once he understands the sword's intention, he will be able to be on par with top powerhouses such as the Lord of Linyue City. And now, even if he has not understood the sword's intention, his strength is much stronger than that of the king-level master of Muyue Auction House.
There are countless people who want to worship him as their teacher, but this Yuansu Sword King has extremely high vision and has only accepted two disciples so far, and this Lu Han is one of them.
As soon as Lu Han's words came out, many people cast envious eyes on Su Lianxin.
This girl is really lucky. It depends on whether she can take Mr. Lu Han's sword next.
Mr. Lu Han, as the second disciple of Sword King Yuansu, has extraordinary talent in swordsmanship. Not to mention those in the same realm, even monks whose realm is higher than his may not be his opponent.
Catch his sword, this seems to be a simple request, but it is actually not simple.
Looking at the young man who started talking to himself as soon as he came up, Su Lian was speechless.
When did I say that I wanted to become your master?
Looking directly at the other person, Su Lianxin said slowly: "First of all, I don't know who your master is, and I have never thought of becoming his master."
"Second."
The words stopped abruptly, and were replaced by a vast sword light, which suddenly slashed past Lu Han's side, and the cold and sharp wind made his face hurt.
The sudden sword made everyone in the arena fall silent.
Lu Han, who was on the stage, looked blankly at the girl in white not far away, the horror in his eyes almost overflowing.
That sword...he didn't even have time to react.
In other words, if the sword just now was aimed at him, then he would be dead.
Of course, this is not the most important thing. The most important thing is that in that sword light, Lu Han actually sensed the true meaning of the sword that was difficult for him to understand...
That trace of the true meaning of swordsmanship made his hair stand on end, and the long sword at his waist was trembling, as if he had encountered some kind of great terror.
As a swordsman, he is very familiar with the true meaning of swordsmanship.
That was exactly what he wanted to understand in his dreams... Sword Intent!
Not the prototype of the sword intention, but the real sword intention!
That trace of true swordsmanship gave him a feeling that was countless times stronger than that of his master!
Master Yuansu Sword King has already understood the rudimentary form of the sword's intention to perfection, and the next step is to reach the true sword's intention.
In the sword light struck by Su Lianxin, he clearly felt that the true meaning of the sword contained in it was far superior to that of his master. What did this mean?
This shows that the girl in white in front of her does not understand the rudimentary form of swordsmanship, but the true meaning of the sword!
A little girl of sixteen or seventeen years old, sword intent?
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, Lu Han would never believe it.
You know, even his master, a king-level sword cultivator, has never understood the meaning of the sword!
The girl in white in front of her, whose realm was comparable to hers, actually...understood the sword intention that even his master Yuansu Sword King had never understood!
At this moment, not to mention Lu Han, even the Sword King Yuansu stood up suddenly on the attic, and the tea cup in his hand had been crushed into powder by him.
Sword King Yuansu was no less shocked than his disciple.
The closer you are to comprehending the sword's intention, the more you understand how difficult it is to comprehend it. Regardless of the rumors from the outside world, Yuansu Sword King is only one step away from comprehending the sword's intention, but only he knows how difficult it is to do so.
How many people are stuck at this stage. The vast majority of swordsmen have been stuck for a lifetime, and they have not been able to understand the meaning of the sword until their death.
But what did he see?
A little girl who was only fifteen or sixteen years old actually understood the meaning of the sword...
What kind of monster is this?
How could such a monster appear in the Seven Kingdoms of Yingyue?
This is no longer something that a genius can describe.

"Apprenticeship? "
After slashing out a sword, Su Lianxin turned around and left. The two words she left behind deeply hurt Lu Han and the Yuansu Sword King in the attic.
What's ridiculous is that Yuansu Sword King actually tried to accept the other party as his disciple.
Who accepts whom as a disciple?
A person who only understands the rudimentary meaning of the sword actually tries to accept a person who has understood the meaning of the sword as his disciple?
